tldr: Staff can now hide a variant in a channel and keep its listing and prices. A listing with is_available_for_purchase false acts as if it does not exist for customers.
goal: Stop selling a variant in a channel for a time, without deleting its prices there.

story.heading: Variant channel listing gets is_available_for_purchase
story.body: The new column is true by default, so every existing listing stays sellable.

story.heading: Sellable now means a price and the flag
story.body: sellable_listing_q and its twin is_sellable define a sellable listing once. Querysets use .sellable() in place of a price check.

story.heading: Mutations set the flag, in bulk or per variant
story.body: productVariantChannelListingAvailabilityUpdate sets it for up to 100 channels. Create, update and bulk mutations take it too.

story.heading: Checkout and promotions now skip hidden variants
story.body: Checkout lines and gift rewards read is_sellable, so a hidden variant is not available and gets no promotion.

story.heading: The whole change
story.body: The Catalog API sets the flag. Catalog defines sellable, and Checkout and Discounts read it. No dependency breaks a rule.

components.summary: New productVariantChannelListingAvailabilityUpdate mutation; variant listing inputs take is_available_for_purchase.
New ProductVariantChannelListingAvailabilityUpdateError type for the new mutation.
A listing is sellable only with a price and the flag on; querysets and price ranges use .sellable().
Checkout lines, prices and problems use is_sellable, so a hidden variant is not available.
Gift rewards of promotions use only sellable variant listings.

decisions.title: A flag on the listing, not a deleted listing
decisions.why: Staff hide a variant in a channel and keep its price, cost and prior price for when they show it again.

decisions.title: A single definition of a sellable listing, in 2 forms
decisions.why: Queries use sellable_listing_q and loaded objects use is_sellable. Checkout, promotions and price ranges read the same rule.
decisions.alternative: Add the flag check to each query that reads price_amount.

decisions.title: An omitted flag keeps the stored value
decisions.why: New listings default to available, so clients before the flag keep creating sellable listings. Updates change the flag only when it is in the input.
decisions.alternative: Treat an omitted flag as false.

decisions.title: Lock the listings, at most 100 per call
decisions.why: select_for_update orders concurrent changes of the same listings. The limit of 100 follows the API rule for input lists.
decisions.alternative: Update without locks and without a limit.

decisions.title: Mark the products dirty in the changed channels
decisions.why: The discounted prices of a product depend on its sellable variants. A background task recalculates them.
decisions.alternative: Recalculate the prices inside the mutation.
